What RWS / TrainAI sells

Prepares AI training data in many languages. Specialists also review AI answers and test systems for harmful behavior.

  • TrainAI — Managed training data in multiple languages, with expert feedback.
  • TrainAI Community — A screened specialist network for AI data work.
  • AI data consulting
  • Generative AI training and fine-tuning — Expert data for model training, including human feedback and carefully designed prompts.
